title: Understanding the Slope in SLR
text: In a Simple Linear Regression model, the slope $$\theta_1$$ represents the change in the response variable for a one-unit change in the predictor variable.

title: Relating Slope to the Context
text: Think about what the predictor variable (hours) and the response variable (rides) represent in this context.

hintAnswer: Estimated average ride increase per additional hour on campus.
title: Interpreting $$\theta_1$$
text: If $$\theta_1$$ is the slope, what does it tell us about the relationship between hours spent on campus and the number of rides taken?
choices: Estimated number of rides taken when no hours are spent on campus.
Estimated average ride increase per additional hour on campus.
Estimated average rides taken by students.
Estimated total number of rides by students in the dataset.
